properties.name: thar_ghaggar_margin
properties.description: Thar desert margin of the Ghaggar-Hakra / Chautang system on the Indian side: southern Sri Ganganagar and Hanumangarh, northern Bikaner, northern Churu. The eastern continuation of Cholistan, where machine-learning survey found hundreds of unrecorded mounds. The international-border buffer is subtracted at runtime.

properties.name: bikaner_churu_gap
properties.description: Dune-covered tract between the Ghaggar and the Sothi/Chautang line (Lunkaransar, Sardarshahar, Taranagar). Least systematically surveyed part of the primary AOI.

properties.name: haryana_calibration
properties.description: Ghaggar-Chautang plains of Haryana (Sirsa, Fatehabad, Hisar, Jind). Densely surveyed; used to tune the detector against known mounds before sweeping the primary AOI.
